title: Robust LLM Evaluation with Boundedly Bad Judges: A Constrained Maximum Likelihood Approach
abstract: arXiv:2604.03257v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Evaluating language models at scale often involves reconciling costly, but reliable, labels (e.g., from human raters) with cheap, but noisy, proxy labels (e.g., from LLM-as-a-judge autoraters). This paper proposes constrained maximum likelihood estimation (CMLE), a likelihood-based approach to large language model (LLM) evaluation that explicitly models the error in the proxy labels via their true-positive and false-positive rates, subject to data-driven constraints. Functionally, these constraints act as an adaptive regularization that restricts the feasible judge error rates, particularly when the available number of reliable labels is limited. In contrast to asymptotically unbiased estimators (such as those based on prediction-powered inference), this formulation accepts a controlled bias under misspecified constraints in exchange for variance reduction relative to various baselines including unconstrained maximum likelihood

translated_title: 基于有界不良评判者的稳健LLM评估：一种约束最大似然方法
translated_abstract: 大规模评估语言模型通常需要调和昂贵但可靠的标签（例如来自人类评分者的标签）与廉价但含噪的代理标签（例如来自LLM作为评判者的自动评估器）。本文提出了约束最大似然估计（CMLE），这是一种基于似然的LLM评估方法，它通过真阳性率和假阳性率显式建模代理标签中的误差，并受数据驱动约束的限制。在功能上，这些约束起到自适应正则化的作用，限制了可行的评判者错误率，特别是在可用的可靠标签数量有限的情况下。与渐近无偏估计器（例如基于预测驱动推断的估计器）不同，这一表述在约束设定不当时接受受控的偏差，以换取相对于包括无约束最大似然在内的各种基线的方差降低。
tldr: 该论文提出约束最大似然估计（CMLE）方法，通过数据驱动约束显式建模LLM评判者的错误率，以受控偏差换取方差降低，从而在可靠标签有限的情况下实现更稳健的大规模LLM评估。
